adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the refreshOAuthTokens function wraps the original token refresh call. The original code directly assigned the result of hubspotClient.oauth.tokensApi.createToken() to hubspotRefreshToken. With the new code, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response object (from lines 6-14 of refreshOAuthTokens.ts), not the decoded token data. The HubSpot code then tries to use this Response object as HubspotToken credentials without calling .json() on it first. This is a real bug - the Response object would be used directly instead of the parsed JSON token data.
